question: Select all that apply: Which developments marked the organized phase of the war between April and November 1971?

options.text: Mukti Bahini guerrilla operations expanded under sector-based command
Millions of civilians fled to India
Sheikh Mujibur Rahman returned to Bangladesh
Bangladesh–India joint forces advanced on several fronts

explanation: From April to November, guerrilla operations grew under sector commands and millions of civilians crossed into India. The full-scale war began on 3 December, and Mujib returned on 10 January 1972.
